visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation style. Five characters (one male driver, four female/humanoid passengers) are inside a white van. They are all laughing and smiling with wide eyes and open mouths. (2) Exterior shot shows the van driving on a road surrounded by dense green cartoon trees. A warning sign with an exclamation mark appears. (3) Inside the van, the male driver points ahead excitedly while the female passenger in the front looks worried, sweating with a grimace. (4) The van is shown tumbling down a steep brown dirt slope, flipping multiple times with dust clouds and sparks appearing around the vehicle. (5) The van is upside down on a dirt ground with smoke rising from the undercarriage. One character is hanging upside down from a broken window; another is crawling out from under the car. (6) The van explodes in a burst of orange and red flames, then instantly turns into a pile of gray ash. The characters stand nearby, looking shocked. (7) A man is shown holding a smartphone displaying a map and booking interface. (8) Montage of different Tesla car models (S, 3, X, Y) against a light blue background with stars. (9) A green map of Taipei and New Taipei City is displayed. (10) Text overlays appear showing rental prices ($2,500) and discount codes ($2,200) over a silver Tesla car. (11) All characters are back in a white Tesla, driving on a straight gray road while laughing. The screen fades to white with a black logo.

It then seamlessly transitions into a promotional advertisement for 'UDRIVE,' a Tesla rental service in Taiwan, highlighting their car models, ease of booking, and promotional pricing.
